copy_lock.copy: He didn't marry a quiet passenger. He married mission control.
Her foot found the invisible brake.
Maybe love is one steering wheel and two opinions.

agents.summary: Use car/cab behavior receipts as a relationship-IP format, not a romance poster.
Every slide has a visible car/cab action: navigator, turn, invisible brake, AC committee, co-pilot response.
Aachu is animated mission control; Zuv actively makes her co-pilot while driving safely.
Use airy top/side text zones, never covering faces, hands, steering wheel, or passenger foot beat.
Prompts must block unsafe driving, nagging-wife framing, helpless-husband framing, and real map/plate details.
Selected system passes only if it reads as shared co-pilot language.

visual_system_candidates.name: Car/Cab Mission Control Receipts
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Best proves the autopsy gates: public contradiction, receipt density, physical proof, active partner, tag behavior.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Can become nagging wife if Zuv is passive.

visual_system_candidates.name: Dashboard Evidence Board
visual_system_candidates.case_for: Strong object grammar around map, AC, playlist, and road signs.
visual_system_candidates.risk: Too prop-first and could lose the couple.

visual_system_candidates.name: Road-Trip Soft Romance
visual_system_candidates.risk: Fails autopsy by becoming mood instead of behavior receipts.

cross_debate: Reject Road-Trip Soft Romance because it repeats the failed polished-poster problem.
Reject Dashboard Evidence Board as the main system because objects are proof, not the premise.
Repair Car/Cab Mission Control Receipts by making Zuv visibly active, amused, and safe.
why_it_wins: It makes every slide answer: what is she doing, what is he doing back, and why would a viewer tag their partner?
rejected_visual_patterns: quote-card text over empty car background

slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Passenger seat as mission control; Zuv drives safely amused.
Simplified dashboard map arrow, Aachu studying it like navigator.
Aachu points LEFT-LEFT-LEFT with harmless motion lines.
Passenger foot presses imaginary brake, no danger.
AC knobs and playful committee gesture.
Zuv asks Captain, next? with fond active grin.
One steering wheel, two opinions, both in the same safe rhythm.

typography_and_aspect_plan.instagram_post_4x5: Use top or side warm-paper negative space; keep faces, steering wheel, dashboard action, and passenger-foot proof unobstructed.
typography_and_aspect_plan.reels_stories_9x16: Generate natively with taller cabin space; text in upper third unless slide action requires side placement.

generation_prompt_brief.style_lock: warm hand-drawn desi storybook, airy paper, expressive faces, soft imperfect linework
generation_prompt_brief.copy_lock: Render exact slide copy inside each generated artwork.
negative_prompt_additions: no readable map UI, plate number, route name, QR code, or private details

downstream_requirements: visual-debate.json must preserve Car/Cab Mission Control Receipts.
visual-plan-quality.json must mark each slide GO only if the action is safe and relationship-proofed.
prompt-pack.json must include separate native 4:5 and 9:16 prompts.
